title: McDonald's Canada to freeze price of small coffee, drop cost of value meals for one year
summary: McDonald's Canada will freeze the price of a small cup of coffee at $1 for at least a year and drop the price of its McValue meals to $5 for the same duration, its CEO announced on Tuesday.
